# test_sacf_bootstrap {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
test_sacf_bootstrap(data, n_boot, d1, d2; alpha, block_size)
```
Compute a bootstrap hypothesis test for the SACF at lag (d1, d2) and return a [`SACFTestResultBoot`](SACFTestResultBoot.qmd) with the bootstrap critical value, p-value, and reject decision.
 
Unlike [`test_sacf()`](test_sacf.qmd), this does not rely on the asymptotic N(0, 1/MN) distribution and is therefore more reliable for small images.
 
  * `data`: the 2D image (M × N matrix).
  * `n_boot`: number of bootstrap replications.
  * `d1`, `d2`: row and column delays.
  * `alpha`: significance level (default `0.05`).
  * `block_size`: set `> 1` for a 2D block bootstrap that preserves spatial dependencies.


:::
